headlines.headline: Top gainers and losers, October 19: Axis Bank tumbles 4%, TMPV, Infosys fall 3%, JSW Steel rises 2%
headlines.summary: On October 19, the SENSEX declined by 876.38 points or 1.17% to close at 73,852.90, while the NIFTY50 ended at 22,888.95, down by 257.20 points or 1.11%.

headlines.headline: Reliance shares are down 26% this year. What could turn them around?
headlines.summary: Reliance Industries, one of the heaviest stocks in India's benchmark indices, hit a 52-week low on 13 October. A slowdown in retail, delayed telecom tariff hikes and fuel-export uncertainty have weighed on it all year. The next two weeks bring Q2 results, Jio's listing and a possible tariff hike. Could any of these turn the stock around?

headlines.headline: SENSEX, NIFTY50 snap two-day winning streak dragged by HDFC Bank, Axis Bank
headlines.summary: The SENSEX fell as much as 1,021 points and NIFTY50 index touched an intraday low of 22,845 dragged down by losses in HDFC Bank, Axis Bank, ICICI Bank, Infosys and Bharti Airtel.

headlines.headline: Ixigo, PNB, HFCL, L&T among buzzing stocks: SENSEX falls over 1,000 pts from day’s high, NIFTY below 22,900
headlines.summary: Shares of Punjab National Bank (PNB) gained as much as 7.7% to hit an intraday high of ₹125.22 per equity share on October 19, as it saw its standalone net profit rise 12.8% YoY to ₹5,532 crore in the second quarter of FY27.

headlines.headline: FMCG stocks struggle: NIFTY FMCG index down 18% in 2026; why a margin recovery looks elusive
headlines.summary: Latest industry reports said that FMCG companies face sustained margin pressure in the second half of the current fiscal year (H2 FY27) as rising input costs squeeze profitability, with firms weighing post-Diwali price hikes against the risk of hurting consumer demand, particularly in price-sensitive mass-market and rural categories.

headlines.headline: HDFC Bank shares fall over 2% as net interest margin hit new lows of 3.1%, net profit jumps 4.7% YoY
headlines.summary: The marginal dip in margins can largely be attributed to a 20 bps fall in the overall yield on assets to 7.6% for the quarter, as compared with 7.8% in the same period last year and 7.7% in the previous quarter. Declining yield on assets could remain an overhang on the country’s largest private sector lender.

headlines.headline: Top gainers and losers, October 16: TechM rallies 8%, TCS jumps 5%, IndiGo falls 3%; check list
headlines.summary: On October 16, the SENSEX advanced by 413.66 points or 0.56% to close at 74,729.27. Meanwhile, the NIFTY50 ended higher by 148.80 points or 0.65% at 23,146.15.

headlines.headline: Q2 results this week: Infosys, Eternal, Bajaj Finance, Adani Energy, Kotak Mahindra Bank, UltraTech Cement, Tata Motors, Dr Reddy's, HPCL and more
headlines.summary: Thermal power producer Adani Power, zinc producer Hindustan Zinc, NBFC Piramal Finance, on-demand convenience platform Swiggy, hypermarket chain Vishal Mega Mart, pharma company Dr Reddy's Laboratories, and real estate firm Godrej Properties, among others, will also announce their Q2 report cards this week.

headlines.headline: Stocks to watch, Oct 19: HDFC Bank, YES, Axis Bank, HFCL, Vedanta, HZL, DLF, IDBI Bank, IREDA, LTTS
headlines.summary: The country's largest private sector lender, HDFC Bank, on Saturday reported a 5.55% increase in its consolidated net profit for the September quarter (Q2 FY27) to ₹20,700 crore, pointing out that the impact on treasury operations restricted profit growth.

headlines.headline: GIFT NIFTY futures hint at muted opening for Indian markets; Crude oil tops $108 per barrel
headlines.summary: Foreign institutional investors bought shares worth ₹1,165.92 crore on Friday while domestic institutional investors sold shares worth ₹3,661 crore.

headlines.headline: SENSEX, NIFTY50 surge for second straight session led by gains in IT shares
headlines.summary: Infosys, Bharti Airtel, Tata Consultancy Services, Tech Mahindra, HCL Technologies and Bajaj Finance were top movers in the SENSEX.

headlines.headline: ICICI Bank Q2 results: Profit rises 20% YoY to ₹14,843 crore, NIM down 12 basis points; asset quality improves
headlines.summary: ICICI Bank posted a 20% rise in its September quarter profits for FY27 with key support from the lender's rising interest income. Key factors like improvement in asset quality and a marginal fall in the margins will remain in focus of investors.

headlines.headline: HDFC Bank Q2 earnings: Net profit rises 5% to ₹19,510 crore, NII advances 10%; Asset quality improves
headlines.summary: HDFC Bank's net interest income or the difference between interest earned on loans and expended on deposits rose 10% to ₹34,619 crore at the end of the second quarter.

headlines.headline: Jio Platforms IPO: Here's how to apply under Reliance Industries shareholders’ quota
headlines.summary: Jio Platforms IPO has reserved around 12% of total issue or ₹2,500 crore for eligible Reliance Industries shareholders. Investors who held even one share of Reliance Industries on or before October 14, 2026 are eligible to apply under this category.

headlines.headline: Market weekly wrap: SENSEX, NIFTY50 jump 3% led by strong rally in IT stocks; Tech Mahindra, TCS lead gains
headlines.summary: On a weekly basis, broader markets ended mixed and underperformed the main indices as well. Among sectors, the NIFTY IT was the biggest winner, with a rally of 11.7%.
